import re

# Data extracted from the Treasury Bulletin pages
# Format: (month_label, total_federal_securities_outstanding)

]

# FY 1991: July 1990 - June 1991
fy1991_data = [
    ("July 1990", 3200338),
    ("Aug 1990", 3243281),
    ("Sept 1990", 3266073),
    ("Oct 1990", 3307748),
    ("Nov 1990", 3363205),
    ("Dec 1990", 3397325),
    ("Jan 1991", 3443129),
    ("Feb 1991", 3488624),
    ("Mar 1991", 3491694),
    ("Apr 1991", 3470530),
    ("May 1991", 3522261),

]

# FY 1992: July 1991 - June 1992
fy1992_data = [
    ("July 1991", 3597294),
    ("Aug 1991", 3636298),
    ("Sept 1991", 3683054),
    ("Oct 1991", 3735584),
    ("Nov 1991", 3766152),
    ("Dec 1991", 3820403),
    ("Jan 1992", 3826612),
    ("Feb 1992", 3844741),
    ("Mar 1992", 3897204),
    ("Apr 1992", 3907963),
    ("May 1992", 3950469),
    ("June 1992", 4000678),
]

# FY 1993: July 1992 - June 1993
fy1993_data = [
    ("July 1992", 4025949),
    ("Aug 1992", 4064327),
    ("Sept 1992", 4082871),
    ("Oct 1992", 4085732),
    ("Nov 1992", 4151504),
    ("Dec 1992", 4195926),
    ("Jan 1993", 4185886),
    ("Feb 1993", 4216166),
    ("Mar 1993", 4250287),
    ("Apr 1993", 4274361),
    ("May 1993", 4316774),
    ("June 1993", 4372677),
]

# Calculate sums for each fiscal year
fy1990_sum = sum([x[1] for x in fy1990_data])
fy1991_sum = sum([x[1] for x in fy1991_data])
fy1992_sum = sum([x[1] for x in fy1992_data])
fy1993_sum = sum([x[1] for x in fy1993_data])

print("Monthly data for each fiscal year:")
print(f"\nFY 1990 (July 1989 - June 1990):")
for month, value in fy1990_data:
    print(f"  {month}: {value:,}")
print(f"  Sum: {fy1990_sum:,}")

print(f"\nFY 1991 (July 1990 - June 1991):")
for month, value in fy1991_data:
    print(f"  {month}: {value:,}")
print(f"  Sum: {fy1991_sum:,}")

print(f"\nFY 1992 (July 1991 - June 1992):")
for month, value in fy1992_data:
    print(f"  {month}: {value:,}")
print(f"  Sum: {fy1992_sum:,}")

print(f"\nFY 1993 (July 1992 - June 1993):")
for month, value in fy1993_data:
    print(f"  {month}: {value:,}")
print(f"  Sum: {fy1993_sum:,}")

print("\n\nSummary - Fiscal Year Sum (in millions):")
print(f"FY 1990: {fy1990_sum:,}")
print(f"FY 1991: {fy1991_sum:,}")
print(f"FY 1992: {fy1992_sum:,}")
print(f"FY 1993: {fy1993_sum:,}")

# Now perform linear regression
# x = fiscal year (1990, 1991, 1992, 1993)
# y = sum of outstanding at end of each month for the fiscal year

x = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]
y = [fy1990_sum, fy1991_sum, fy1992_sum, fy1993_sum]

# Calculate linear regression coefficients
n = len(x)
sum_x = sum(x)
sum_y = sum(y)
sum_xy = sum([x[i]*y[i] for i in range(n)])
sum_x2 = sum([x[i]**2 for i in range(n)])

slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\n\nLinear Regression Results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"Equation: y = {slope:.4f}x + {intercept:.4f}")

# Project for FY 1995
fy1995_projected_sum = slope * 1995 + intercept
fy1995_average = fy1995_projected_sum / 12

print(f"\n\nProjection for FY 1995:")
print(f"Projected sum: {fy1995_projected_sum:,.2f} million")
print(f"Projected average (sum/12): {fy1995_average:,.2f} million")
print(f"Rounded to nearest whole number: {round(fy1995_average)}")

mean_y = statistics.mean(y)

# Calculate slope and intercept

denominator = sum((x[i] - mean_x)**2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

print(f"\nRegression:")

print(f"intercept = {intercept}")

# Project for FY 1995
fy1995_sum = slope * 1995 + intercept
fy1995_avg = fy1995_sum / 12
